body: THESSA, archmage of the elven city of Evermore, leader of the Ljosalfar in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: a wood elf; female; ageless, looks in her twenties; slender. Pale skin, a delicate oval face, long straight black hair, long pointed elf ears, dark green eyes.
costume: a high-collared gown of deep forest green and black with gold trim.
signature: A single GOLD FEATHER is always tucked into her black hair.

vibes.name: Sacrifice Bride
vibes.line: Her right hand drawing the viewer, her new husband, closer, her left hidden in the folds of her gown, closed on a tucked dagger; a small tender smile, tears running, eyes with no catchlight fixed on the viewer; under the great red oak by moonlight, lanterns dying.
vibes.wears: a high-collared elven wedding gown of deep forest green and black with gold trim, a sheer veil falling down her back, ribbons in her hair.

vibes.name: Gold Feather
vibes.line: Both hands cupped around an acorn that is splitting and sprouting into a sapling between her fingers, roots spilling over her wrists, the gold feather in her hair glowing; eyes on the sprout, lips parted, brow drawn in concentration; a sunlit glade of Evermore at bright morning, green-gold light.
vibes.wears: a working mage's clothes: a sleeveless tunic of pale gold silk over an ivory underdress, the sleeves bound up above the elbow with cord, a satchel of seeds.

vibes.name: Red Oak Rite
vibes.line: Her right hand tipping a silver cup of wine over the roots of the great red oak, its leaves reddening above as it soaks in, her left holding a stolen black grimoire open against her hip; eyes unblinking on the roots, lips moving; alone at violet dusk, ground mist.
vibes.wears: a hooded mage's cloak of deep oxblood red, the hood pushed back, over a plain black gown, a black cord belt hung with small pouches.

vibes.name: Evermore Archmage
vibes.line: Her right hand planting a staff of living wood on a high bridge, new shoots twining round her wrist, her left closing a great leaf-bound spellbook against her side; chin level, mouth calm and closed, eyes straight at the viewer; the tree towers of Evermore at golden late afternoon.
vibes.wears: the archmage's formal robes: a long white robe embroidered with climbing ivy in green and silver thread, a silver mantle, a tall standing collar of carved pale wood.
